text:
Ravi N: Pushing a compact redesign for Alerting > Channels. Goal: super-dense list for orgs with 30+ channels. Staging: /design/alerts/compact-v4.
Tess B: Nice. One immediate ask: how do we indicate per-channel threshold overrides at a glance?
Ravi N: Small inline badge: "Override: 3m". Click opens a focused modal for exact editing.
Omar H: Accessibility: that badge needs role="status" and strong contrast. Current yellow fails on dark theme.
Gina L: Copy: ops prefers "Silence" over "Mute" across product. If we switch, add microcopy: "Silence notifications until [time]" on confirm.
Ravi N: Agreed. Also adding a subtle drag handle for reordering (persist per-project). Will show toast "Order saved (Undo)".
Tess B: For Test flow, change "Send preview" -> "Preview notification" and add confirm when recipient count > 10.
Omar H: Keyboard notes: accordion rows must support Enter/Space, aria-expanded, and focus rings on draggable handles. Flyout for suppression must trap focus and announce "Suppression settings for <channel>".
DesignBot: Preview deployed (changeset #589). Please test NVDA/VoiceOver and mobile 1-column variant.
Ravi N: Thanks — will iterate on color tokens and reduce expand animation to 160ms. Back with updates tomorrow.
